regler.bemaerkning: Quality-gaten i pluginnet afviser captions med >= 0,85 ord-overlap, dode links og manglende billede. Hver caption nedenfor er skrevet til at sta alene.

items.title: Clockwork Figurehead — Steampunk Poster 30x40 / 50x70
items.body: She is half figurehead, half mechanism: a brass-ribbed woman carved into the bow of a ship that never docks. Printed to order in 30x40 and 50x70 cm, text-free, in muted teal and aged brass. Part of the Clockwork Punk series on steamgears.eu. #steampunk #wallart #clockwork #posterart #darkacademia

items.title: Clockwork Tea Robots — Whimsigoth Tee
items.body: Two little brass robots pour tea for nobody, forever, and somehow that is the most comforting thing on the shirt. Unisex cut, printed on demand. The detail is the joke: every gear is doing its job. $26.95 on steamgears.eu. #whimsigoth #steampunk #teeprint #clockwork

items.title: Clockwork Rose — Herbarium Art Print
items.body: A rose that will never open and never rot, catalogued like a specimen from a Victorian greenhouse. Herbarium print, ready to frame beside a desk. $29.95, printed to order. Give it to the person who keeps dried flowers in books. #herbarium #darkacademia #artprint #clockwork #gothicdecor

items.title: The Aeronaut — Brass Skeleton Pocket Watch
items.body: The gift that ends the search for a gift: a brass skeleton pocket watch where you can watch the movement work. No screen, no battery, no notification. $149 at steamgears.eu, and it arrives in time if you order this week. #pocketwatch #giftideas #steampunk #brass

items.title: Brass Luna Moth — Herbarium Art Print
items.body: Wings pinned open like a museum specimen, except every vein is a wire and every scale is a rivet. Brass Luna Moth from the Herbarium set, $29.95, printed to order for frames in 30x40 or larger. Quiet enough for a bedroom wall. #lunamoth #darkacademia #mothart #steampunk #wallart

items.title: Clockwork Owl — Dark Academia Hoodie
items.body: An owl assembled from escapements, staring like it has already read the book you are holding. Heavy hoodie, unisex fit, $49.95. Wear it to a lecture, a LARP or the supermarket at midnight; the owl does not judge. #darkacademia #hoodie #steampunk #owl #clockwork

items.title: Clockwork Rose — Herbarium Phone Case
items.body: The smallest canvas in the shop: a clockwork rose behind glass on the back of your phone. $24.95, fitted per model. Detail worth zooming in on, which is a strange thing to say about a phone case. #phonecase #darkacademia #herbarium #clockwork #steampunk

items.title: Ink and Steam — Clockwork Charm Bracelet
items.body: Brass charms, gears and keys on one chain, so it rattles faintly when you move. $69, and it is the piece people ask about rather than compliment. Built for wrists that already own too many rings. #jewellery #steampunk #brass #charmbracelet #clockwork

items.title: The Clockwork Seer — Tarot Tee
items.body: A fortune teller with a clock for a face, which is either a warning or a business model. Unisex tee, $26.95, printed when you order it. Ideal for the friend who owns three tarot decks and no plan. #tarot #steampunk #witchy #teeprint #clockwork

items.title: Clockwork Heart — Gothic Romance Hoodie
items.body: A heart with visible workings, which is the most honest Valentine anyone has printed. $49.95, unisex, warm enough for a November queue outside a venue. Buy it for yourself and call it research. #gothichoodie #steampunk #darkromance #clockwork #valentine

items.title: Clockwork Octopus — Curiosity Hoodie
items.body: Eight arms of brass tubing around a glass eye, drawn like a plate from a naturalist's notebook. Hoodie, $49.95. The sort of print you notice on the third meeting rather than the first. #octopus #steampunk #hoodie #naturalhistory #clockwork

items.title: Clockwork Seer — Brass Pocket Watch Pendant
items.body: Worn on a chain, it reads as an heirloom from a family that never existed. Brass pendant watch, $89, and the dial is the whole argument. Finishes the Clockwork Punk series we have been posting for twelve days. #pocketwatch #brass #steampunk #pendant #clockwork
